note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved; ZInQ.Zs.euclideanDomain a definition: The PID instance gives class number one (by a Euclidean argument, not Minkowski), Zs_unit_sqClass with unit_sqClass_iff gives exactly four unit square classes told apart by sign vectors, and isSquare_of_totallyPositive_unit gives that totally positive units are squares. That Z[s] is the full ring of integers is not stated (only the inclusion ZInQ.toOK); proved.

instance euclideanDomain : EuclideanDomain Zs :=
  { (inferInstance : CommRing Zs), (inferInstance : Nontrivial Zs) with
    quotient := (· / ·)
    remainder := (· % ·)
    quotient_zero := fun x => by
      rw [div_def]; ext <;> simp
    quotient_mul_add_remainder_eq := fun x y => by rw [mod_def]; ring
    r := _
    r_wellFounded := (measure (Int.natAbs ∘ QuadraticAlgebra.norm)).wf
    remainder_lt := natAbs_norm_mod_lt
    mul_left_not_lt := fun a _ hb0 => not_lt_of_ge <| natAbs_norm_le_mul a hb0 }
